vegas-robaina-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Created in 1997, Vegas Robaina honours Cuba's growers through Alejandro Robaina, whose family has farmed tobacco since 1845 at Cuchillas de Barbacoa in San Luis, in the Vuelta Abajo; every size is long filler and rolled by hand. The Famosos robusto opens on coffee and roasted chestnut, then settles into earth, wood, cocoa and cream before a toasty close.

thirds.notes: Coffee and roasted chestnut lead, softened by cream and sweetness over earth, with a cayenne-like spice on the finish.
The flavours round out into earth, wood and chocolate with nuts, as the smoke thickens and smooths.
Earth turns toward dark-roast coffee with cream and spice and a toastier smoke; the Únicos ends on walnut wood and leather.

vegas-robaina-cuba--edicion-regional-en-.description: Vegas Robaina has served for several Ediciones Regionales, made from the brand's usual blend in sizes outside the regular range and sold in numbered boxes for one market. The Petit Robaina for Canada, released in 2009 at 110 x 52 mm in the Petit Edmundo format, smokes woody and sweet with earth and cocoa, gathering spice toward the end.

thirds.notes: A woody sweetness with earth and cocoa, rich in flavour yet restrained.
The same profile carries on, with a light touch of spice and a brief flicker of cinnamon.
Spice builds while the woody, earthy core stays steady to the end.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Vegas Robaina Petit Robaina (Canada Regional Edition) review
